title: Absolutely love SHEIN!!
content: As a high school senior navigating the delicate balancing act of saving up for college while aspiring to build a more sophisticated and adult-like wardrobe, SHEIN has been nothing short of my fashion savior. The allure lies in its vast repertoire of styles, an expansive playground where I can explore and experiment, all without emptying my piggy bank. It's a journey of self-discovery through clothing, and here's why I adore SHEIN. The sheer diversity of styles they offer is like a treasure trove waiting to be explored. It's not merely a store; it's a canvas where I can paint my fashion identity, and it doesn't cost me an arm and a leg. I have a soft spot for all the pieces I've acquired from SHEIN. Granted, some of my friends have faced hiccups with their purchases - issues that are par for the course with online shopping and the intricacies of shipping. However, SHEIN's customer service has consistently come to the rescue, ensuring that they either receive the correct item or a swift replacement. Now, I've heard murmurs about concerns regarding the quality of SHEIN's garments. But let's be real, folks - when you're snagging those popular, cute, and trend-setting pieces at such affordable prices, it's unrealistic to expect the world's finest fabrics. We have to set our expectations right. If a $5 shirt happens to be a tad fragile or feels slightly unconventional, that's just the nature of budget-friendly fashion. It's like comparing apples and oranges. If you desire a $50 shirt for what's termed as "better quality," you might be in for a surprise because, more often than not, it's the same song, different verse.

title: Not the devil they’re made out to be.
content: Honestly, I avoided Shein for a long time bc of all the bad publicity the media likes to give them. I finally decided to check it out myself and I have been incredibly pleased with their products and services. I’ve purchased skirts and dresses from Shein for $30 or less that would’ve run me $100+ at a name-brand retail store and the quality is no different. I also appreciate the point system and how you earn rewards for giving reviews on their merchandise. You’d think for that reason that’d be crappy reviews but I have used them religiously to guide my purchases. Many reviews are from shoppers just like me and YOU who were hesitant to use Shein at first bc of the biased media coverage but gave them a chance. I’m not a millionaire and I have to watch my spending. Shein meets me half ways. I also doubt I (or we, as in ‘fast fashion’ consumers) have such an influence on a country’s economy that we would shut down the system. We are also not solely responsible for livable wages or worker safety. I’m not buying into that deflection. Do what you may with my review but check out the app and form your own opinion from personal experience before you follow others.

title: No human contact
content: First off, the site has variety of things to be purchased. However, if there’s an issue with something, there’s no human contact or phone number to speak to anyone. Only a bot that keeps repeating the same thing over and over. I placed an order and did a return because the stuff I ordered was too big and just wanted to exchange it. Well, no way to exchange, you have to return it get a refund and reorder. Well, I did this and sent my stuff back the very next day which was 12 days ago. I still have no refund or any info or anyone to talk to about it. And mind you, this was my first time using this company and will be the last. Feels like a scam to me now. I spent well over $100 on clothes, which is a fair amount for what they charge for clothing and it was a tester order with the thought of ordering more, but now I’m truly irritated with not being able to speak or text a human. How can you have a company without people to answer real questions?  They have decent reviews and I could have had a rare experience, but really not feeling them after this.

title: Long-time customer finally driven away for good
content: Shein’s product quality, shipping times, and value vs. cost have steadily been getting worse and worse over the years.  Their customer service is absolutely terrible, and will ask your preference for things then intentionally do the exact opposite.  They have several items listed for sale that aren’t in stock (with no plans to restock) so they can force you to accept store credit instead of getting the items you actually purchased.  It’s also nearly impossible for me to find anything that fits my measurements.  I’m naturally long and lean, and Shein doesn’t carry my size at all - the smallest they carry is 2 sizes above in petites (which isn’t anywhere near long enough for my legs) or 3 sizes above in regular - and their clothing is already cut very large.  It’s especially frustrating with all the “Shein for all” advertising making false claims about inclusivity.  Clearly, Shein is NOT for all, and doesn’t even TRY to be.  After dealing with their drastically declining quality, horrible customer service, and complete and utter lack of sizing options to fit me, Shein has finally driven me away for good, losing a long-time customer in the process.  I used to love Shein, but now it just disgusts me.

title: The good and the bad
content:
Yes, Shein is not the most ethical company (honestly not the least either). The app is good. It is user friendly and fairly enjoyable to use.

While the clothes vary in quality, I have many pieces from Shein that have lasted 4+ years. If you follow the washing instructions and treat your clothes well, they last a long time. Fast fashion refers to the idea that these companies produce disposable, low quality garments that are designed and manufactured in a short period of time. If you aren’t buying 40+ items every few months, buying from Shein isn’t a huge deal. If it’s what you can afford and what fits you, there’s not much you can do about it. Other affordable options like Walmart have similar manufacturing processes and environmental impacts. Ethical options usually are more expensive or have limited options (sizes and styles).

The good:
Great app
Resale option in the app
Inexpensive options
Actual plus-size clothing that you want to wear
Variety of styles and aesthetics
Reliable sizing - measurements listed on each garment and usually several reviews
Fast and reliable shipping - most of the time it arrives before estimated date and always has arrived by the estimated date
Easy and free return process

The bad:
Environmentally detrimental
Opaque manufacturing processes
Unethical labor practices
Item quality varies from really bad to really good
Most items are polyester
Sizing is not the same across garments (one 2X pant might have a 38” waist and another may have a 35” waist) but sizing is always listed
Fast fashion and encouragement of overconsumption and high rates of turnover for garments
Micro-trends that won’t be in style for long

title: Ich bin süchtig!
content:
Anfangs war ich, wie so viele auch, skeptisch. Diese Preise- kann man da Qualität erwarten? Ich habe es ausprobiert und mittlerweile kann ich nach weiteren zahlreichen Bestellungen bei SHEIN behaupten, die Qualität ist für diese Preise wirklich erstaunlich gut!

Sauber verarbeitete Nähte, vor allem gerade. Die Stoffe sind je nach Kleidungsstück schön fließend und feminin. Leicht. Im Sommer habe ich wie verrückt Kleider und Tops bestellt, und auch mit Bikinis oder Unterwäsche habe ich nur positive Erfahrungen gemacht. Das Tolle ist, SHEIN hat wie kein anderer, die ausgefallensten und tollsten Kleidungsstücke! Da können H&M und Co. lang nicht mithalten!

Die Bestellung ist einfach, man bekommt regelmäßig Coupons und Punkte, die sich nochmal günstig auf den Endpreis auswirken. Kauf auf Rechnung ist wirklich entspannend, so kann man ausprobieren und einen Teil zurück schicken, ohne direkt den vollen Betrag vorleisten zu müssen. Die Rückabwicklung geht so schnell, dass letztendlich nur noch die Differenz eingezogen wird, bzw. überweisen muss.

Ich bin mit ALLEM mehr als zufrieden!! Mittlerweile bestelle ich dort auch für meine Teenie Tochter :)
Macht weiter so!! :)

This was my first experience with this store and I absolutely hate it and will never shop with them again. Beware, they will take your money, send you incorrect items, and not fully refund you!

title: It’s majority of my closet & boosted my confidence ✨
content: I know people think it’s wrong to shop with a retailer such Shein because it’s technically or allegedly fast fashion, but it’s really not all that you think or especially expect. First of all, you have to read through the reviews! Not only does it help to find if it’ll be right for you (trust me), but everyone does it because it earns you points. Points earned are $$ you can use to discount the orders you place! And the more points, the bigger the percentage off! Not to mention that if anyone likes your review(s), you get points for that too. Of course, not everything is going to be perfect. But if you’re only buying the $5 & below stuff, then it’s kind of your own fault 😅 I haven’t been disappointed yet, seriously. I have about 5 pairs of different types of shoes from here, a pair of slippers too. And a big chunk of clothing. Which is what leads me into my main point (sorry, got side tracked), this store/app has helped me be able to achieve how I’ve always wanted to without having to break my budget. No matter how hard I work and save, I still can’t seem to afford the nicer or “non-fast fashion” brands (which, let’s face it, there’s really no such thing, if we’re being real). But Shein’s clothing has helped me be able to finally dress how I want, in the style I’ve always wanted to create - and still be able to afford it (instead of just going without it, dressing boring/with the same old clothes I’ve had for years. but hey? at least I can pay just all my bills & that’s it 👍🏼🥴). My point is, Shein gave me my confidence back and also the boost I needed with confidence as well as courage to dress how I want, when and wherever I want - even if that means being overdressed 💋

title: HORRIBLE SHOPPING APP
content:
Please read. For all of the 5 star reviews that make shein look legit. It is not. It’s a horrible shopping app. At first shein was cool, I got all my things I ordered and received fine. The app makes it look like the clothes you get are cheap and comfortable, but most of them are cool designs that don’t last for long depending on how much you wash it. Materials you receive are either itchy, sheer, thin, or too thick. If you do receive a good materiales something, you will find that 1 or more things are a complaint. The order I paid for, was for 4 items, a hoodie, phone case, necklace, and a pair of socks. Doesn’t seem like a big deal, right? I ordered this on Sep. 21st and the tracking feature said it would come in on Oct. 3-6. I expected my order to come in a few days late. After a week and a half I was starting to get tired of looking out for it. A few days after I ordered it, the hoodie I bought said it was out of stock. I didn’t think I wouldn’t get it. I thought I ordered it before it got sold out. I messaged them about it and ‘Joe’ tried to help me. I told him my problem and said he would contact me back. I have not yet received the message. I keep looking to see if I had any notifications. And saw that I did. It said that the hoodie I bought, just got refunded. Me nor my family did this. So I got really mad. Not only did I not receive the  4 things I bought, I will only be getting the 3. The main complaint that I am making, is that It took shein almost a whole month (26ish days) to not tell me there was a problem with my order, but took them 5 minutes to tell me I’m not getting my item.

So disappointed in Shein and will not be buying again. Way to go..

content:
1st, the good bits.  Deals aplenty, variety is insane (home stuff, jewelry, pets, accessories, even things for laundry, etc ad nauseam), I couldn’t possibly look at everything. In all honesty I will still buy from SHEIN.  1 star off for the fabric.  Speed of delivery is excellent.  And why do I love those little baggies stuff is packed in?! LOL Thanks SHEIN.

title: 向き不向きはある
content:
結論から言うと個人的にはめっちゃいいし、3回購入したけど全部大きな破損もなく届いた。
だけど友達が中身が空で袋だけ届いたってイン○タのストーリーで言ってた。(その後の対応は不明)

発送は早いけど、空飛んで運ばれてくるから速達みたいな感じで書いてあっても10日前後かかる印象。
壊れやすい物買う人は布製品と一緒に買うと無事に届きやすいらしい。
海外から来るのに2000円以上買えば送料無料なのと、どの商品買ってもSHEINっていう1つのショップだからお店ごとの送料とかないのが推しポイント。
しかも2000円でもアクセサリーとかネイルパーツなら大量に買い込めるくらい安い。

お洋服買いたい人はレビューしっかり見た方が良さそう。質感とか丈感とかで失敗してる人が多いイメージ。
アクセサリーはレビューないものでも、私が買ったものはしっかりしたのが届いた。
あとマイナスレビュー書いてる人に結構いるのが、サイズが思ったより〇〇ってやつ。サイズはサイズガイドチェックしてから買うのが吉。

コスプレやってる人とハンドメイドやってる人におすすめしたい。
キャラウィッグ風のものが安く売ってたり、衣装作ったりアレンジしたりする時に使える小物が豊富。
私は衣装のアレンジとか小物を作る材料を買ってるけど、安くて衣装のクオリティ上がるから最高。
質はそこそこだけどハンドメイドに必要な材料が安くて大容量だから、失敗しても凹まない。
ただネイルパーツとか〇〇個入りの表記があっても、少し足りなかったり多かったりする。

すぐ使う用事ではなくて、良質なものじゃなくても大丈夫で、数が足りなくてもまあいっかって思える人はハマると思う。
物にもよるけどお値段以上な物も結構あったり、お店とかで売られてるのと全く同じものが半額以下で売られてたりする。(800円だか900円で買ったかわいい靴下が300円くらいで売っててショック受けた)

content: I love so many things about SHEIN. I like to pronounce it, Shine! They always have my size which is usually hard to find. You can filter for better material quality if you’re like me and prefer/need natural fibres. The shipping and returns aren’t scammy like lots of other international companies. I find that if you follow their descriptions everything is generally spot on size wise, and it’s affordable for very poor people like me. Alas, I can’t give a full five bc of the unfair labour practices that keep being mentioned online. I also follow some tiktok creators who have had their designs stolen from SHEIN which isn’t cool. There could be more care for the environment. The shipping is pretty slow but tbh if it were faster in this current climate it’d only drive up the prices so I’m cool with planning ahead a bit. Lots to love and trust about SHEIN and they aren’t worse ethically than other high street brands but are cheaper and have my size so they beat the competition in many ways but definitely have some serious room for improvement. Trustworthy for actually getting what you ordered and being able to return it without much hassle which is pretty major.

title: lead has been founding in their clothing
content: Personally I am a daily Shein shopper, however, I’m also a Medical student and upon some research about lead and it’s affects in the brain I found that Shein clothing was tested for lead and it came back positive via peer reviewed journal articles. This was not a surprise as it is made in China and when I was a kid I had a teacher tell us that China was using chemical warfare such as lead to poison our products to slowly kill people. That made complete sense to me as everything is mostly made in China. So please handle your Shein items with gloves or plastic bags wrapped around your hands and throw in the washer immediately without other clothing, wash them with a second rinse cycle and then do a rinse cycle in the machine after removing the clothing to remove residual lead. Lead is highly toxic and causes many diseases such as cancer and others. Buyers be careful! I still shop at Shein because they have the best outfits for the best prices. But that is the process I use to rid them of lead! Hope this helps all who shop at Shein.

author: bunnyhopkin

title: Styling on a budget
content: I slick have a SHEIN addiction. There’s always ways to save money whether it be from checking in daily for reward points, frequent coupons they have, sales they always have and even writing reviews gains you points which is about as equivalent as a penny because every 100 points, it’s a dollar off. They usually always have a spend over a certain amount and get free express shipping. Over the past 6 months or so, they have really stepped their shipping game up. I’ve been getting my packages a few days earlier then estimated. Just like all online stores, you have to really read the reviews to know what you’re getting and because you do get points for putting up reviews you see a lot of I NEED POINTS PLEASSSSEEEE reviews, but there are some really helpful reviews in every item I’ve been interested in. Seeing how an item fits on someone who has similar measurements as you or seeing the fabric and how it lays on someone other than the model advertising it, is extremely helpful. You can buy literally anything on there from house storage supplies, makeup, shoes, jewelry, kids clothes, little Knick knacks, it’s pretty neat. I’ve only personally gotten clothes and recently some rings, so I can’t vouch on the Misc things they sell. But you can get some great high quality clothes and accessories. They also let you pay with after pay and a few other payment options so even if your cart is over $100, you really only need at least $25 give or take depending on the taxes and such, because at least with after pay, it’s broken down into a 4 payment plan that you pay every two weeks so it’s not a hard hit to the wallet immediately. I Hope this helps!

title: Favourite shopping app
content: Such a huge selection of stunning dresses & lovely things. Easiest shopping site to navigate on the whole net. Has a better & more efficient built in search engine than Google. Although everything is made in China, the cut is not for Oriental women. There’s breathing room & flexibility in every garment. Beautiful, cool, comfortable fabrics, well tailored & always a flattering cut. So affordable I’ve bought my favourite dresses in many colours & bought 2 of each of my favourite colours in each range as I wear their summer dresses everyday & have tons of their black & white suit style dresses which look so expensive & smart so as to make you feel confident when walking around posh department stores & you get treated with respect by their staff (as we know, some posh department stores judge us on how we look & discriminate against us if we don’t look the part.) Such a huge selection. I’ve bought tons of gorgeous dresses & loads of stunning belts. I’m probably gonna buy some of their crystals next time I do a big shop. Just wish their crystal range was wider & slightly cheaper as the same crystals are half the price on Alliexpress, so are some higher quality, bigger crystals. Most stuff arrives fast so they obviously have warehouses in U.K. You don’t have to wait for them to ship it from China like other All Chinese made sites. It’s my favourite place to buy dresses but there are cheaper sources for the exact same homeware & same cosmetic related products, the latter of which I wouldn’t buy as ALL Chinese cosmetics are tested on animals & in Labs with No Animal Welfare rules, checks, standards or limits.

title: I love the clothes at SHEIN but
content: I personally love most everything I get from SHEIN and the prices are great for someone in high school saving for college. However my only problem is the size ranges. In most outfits I like they don’t have my size so it’s a major disappointment. Especially when I fall in love with something and go to put it in my cart and see it only offers small, medium, and large. I just wish their clothing was more size inclusive. I am in that weird spot where I am not plus size but I’m not normal sizes. I can wear a large shirt but I prefer x-large to be comfortable. But while they might have more options with x-large it caught my attention how much isn’t available to plus size. My hips are wide so when it comes to the pants section I need like a double x and in most of the items they don’t offer that. Meaning for most plus size or even slightly bigger than “normal” people they aren’t included in most of the store which is a very sad thing. I love most of the item I can find and that’s the 3 stars but I can’t give them 5 until they fix there issues and be completely size inclusive.

title: Never looked back
content:
I admit I was a little hesitant to order anything at first, I thought it would be poor quality and the wait times horrendous. Not so. Not so at alllllll.

Firstly once I decided to order - I thought I’d start small - impossible! There’s so much gorgeous stuff! Quite a large order with free express delivery (I still thought it would take ages) and also 25% off due to order size. The amount of compliments I have had on my clothes have been ridiculous, including the style and quality and I love them. I had lost some confidence in myself and my appearance so the order was a wardrobe overhaul. I have never looked back. The delivery came in 2, first one arrived within days and the second just after a week. I didn’t return a single item (though I have been assured by my 18yr old daughter that returns are super simple).

Today I have ordered some things for my mother in law, and also my 9yr old daughter (as well as some more things for me! Haha) I am so excited to receive my order. Again free express shipping and also 25% discount. If you get to the pay screen and it seems too much, double check and press cancel - you may not have applied your discount. It asks if you want it all back in your basket, say yes, go back through checkout and apply any discount codes you are eligible for. Simples.

ENJOY!

Nicht empfehlenswert für Unterstützung gegen Kindergewalt und Umwelt Organisationen. Kann aber für Menschen mit wenigem Geld einzig möglich sein. content: I loved Shein when they used USPS, my packages were always delivered on time and never delivered to the wrong house or lost in transit. Shein has unfortunately lost my business due to using sketchy delivery companies!

title: 大人のサンホみたい
content:
インスタ広告で気になる服があって初めて利用してみました。
海外通販サイトはハンドメイドの物で利用したことがありましたが、sheinはその半分以下の日数で届いたと思います。
梱包は国内通販のように丁寧ではないです。
大きな袋で届きましたが何箇所か穴が…笑
商品は個包装で緩衝材などは入っておらず、プラスチックの大きいボトルとか頼んでたので割れてないか心配でした。大丈夫でしたが！
あと入力した住所は合ってるはずなのに表示されたお届け先は地区名が抜けていて、とりあえず届くのを待っていたら佐川急便から住所分からないと電話が来ました。
配達員さんには住所間違ってたみたいで、すみません！と言われましたがどこで変わっちゃったんだろう…

届いた服自体はかわいいけど値段相応って感じでした。トップス正面の生地にヨレ？癖？がついていて取れない😭生地も薄めでしたが夏服なので涼しくて良いのかもしれん。
ちなみに服は色々見た感じ、春夏服だからか肩腹脚出しが多かったです。
露出多めのぴったりめの服が好きな人は特に向いてそう。
流行りの腹チラ服可愛いのたくさんありましたが胃腸が雑魚なので諦めました…
他にも雑貨など注文してみました。
細々した雑貨は見るだけで楽しくて、昔やってたサ○宝石を思い出しました笑

title: If you want cheap, great quality clothes, look here.
content: I have never been so impressed with a clothing company. I am a straight up broke senior in highschool and I bought my graduation dress for $15 and it’s gotten way more compliments than everyone else’s $200 dress from other places. If you’re trying to see if this is a good app or if it’s trustworthy, the only thing you have to worry about is the sizes. Which can be fixed by simply reading the reviews. I ordered a bridesmaid dress for $70 and it is SO NICE. Better than my $300 prom dress from a wedding shop. I recommend to my grave.

title: This app has come a long way!
content: When I first started ordering from SHEIN four years ago, it was with the understanding that everything was a hit or a big miss. It wasn’t much different than Wish, in that you’d definitely get your order, but perhaps not for months after placing it, and even then it might be wrong, of poor quality, or delivered elsewhere. Those days are long gone! Since mid-2020 I’ve almost exclusively shopped at SHEIN for clothes each spring and fall, stuff for my pets, jewelry and makeup brushes, home decor, kitchen tools, and even shoes and bags! My wardrobe is 95% SHEIN and I’m happy to say items I’ve been wearing for over two years are still holding up, regardless of hundreds of wears and washes. My dog loves his collapsible water bowls on our hikes and his back-seat cover on car rides. My cats love their toys. My boyfriend l loves my clothes, too! Denim shorts, matching PJ sets and onesies, lingerie, thigh-high socks, phone and iPad cases, hats, sandals, crop tops and tank tops, two-piece sets for home and going out, slippers, cute jackets and sweaters, rompers, dresses, car washing gear and the list goes on! I’d post a picture of my closet if I could! I probably have 250+ pieces by SHEIN in my home, between clothes and accessories and stuff for my house and pets and car. If you’re looking for an affordable way to replace your worn out active wear, enhance your business casual attire, feel simultaneously cute, comfy and Zoom-appropriate working from home, get ready for the beach, or buy a dress to wear to this season’s weddings, look no further. You can put together an outfit from tops to bottoms, a bag, shoes, jewelry, hair accessories and more all for $25. I dare you to try! I can’t say enough positive stuff about SHEIN. I’m hitting the beach again this weekend and my biggest issue is needing to choose one bikini out of the 25ish I’ve bought from SHEIN in the last two years! (I live at the beach; don’t judge me.)

title: Good App Fun inexpensive products!
content: I really like SHIEN. The app works greats. It’s basically flawless. Easy to use, fun to use, and never any problems. The products on here so diverse. They are also very inexpensive. You get what you pay for so I do recommend really reading the ratings and reviews of products, as well as the products dimensions, sizes (the sizes are Asian sizes so run smaller than US), and descriptions. But after spending lots of hundreds of dollars on SHEIN products I can honestly say I have had only two products that didn’t meet the quality I expected. And the customer service I received about them was very good. I have only ever done one return for a few sweaters and that was the first time I ordered from them. After that I havent had any problems and pay attention to the size and material. The return I did have went great. Easy to return. Once they recieved the item very prompt and correct. Just Beware of shipping times with them always. It’s mostly from China so It can take awhile to get your package, but the app does provide good tracking and from my experiences very good, efficient customer service with any issues or questions I have had. I love that SHIEN has a rewards program where you can earn daily points by checking in, and also by reviewing the products you order. It adds up if you stay on top of checking and write reviews. The coupons the app provides as well as the sales are really good too! I would recommend this app and SHEIN products to almost anyone.

title: Ich bin begeistert
content:
Die App wurde mir von einer Arbeitskollegin empfohlen. Natürlich habe ich die App relativ schnell getestet und war positiv überrascht. Diese Qualität hatte ich nicht erwartet. Auch ich habe quasi quer durch das Sortiment bestellt, von Kleidung, Schminke , Küchenuntensilien und Haushaltsartikel.
1. Die Kleidung hat super gepasst , Stoff und Qualität sind super und definitiv nicht schlechter als H&M und Co.. Auch die Auswahl an großen Größen begeistert mich total. Für mich sind als Hilfe die Massangaben beim Anklicken der Größen super.
2. Die SHEIN Schminke ist der absolute Hammer. Ich habe Lidschatten und Rouge bestellt. Die Farben sind intensiv und halten lang. Auch ein Pinselset hatte ich bestellt. Solch eine Qualität habe ich in Deutschland noch nicht gesehen.
3. Die Badebomben kann ich wärmstens empfehlen, jedoch könnte hier die Auswahl größer sein.
3. Die Qualität der Küchenuntensilien war nicht zu bemängeln. Die Qualität war definitiv nicht schlechter als in Deutschland.
4. Ich hatte Überwurf Decken bestellt. Eigentlich dafür wenn ich abends auf der Couch sitze und mir kalt ist. Qualität ist super. Die Decke nutzen wir jetzt im Winter als zusätzliche Decke, da Sie sehr groß war. Ich habe nachbestellt , diese Decken liegen nun als Schutz vor Schmutz auf der Couch.

Alles in allen empfehlenswert, da man auch auf Rechnung bestellen kann. Ich habe bereits schon wieder einige Male bestellt. Nun nutze ich die Mode in den großen Größen als Schwangerschaftsmode , da mir hier nichts gefallen hat.

title: Looooooove Shein!
content: Shein makes really affordable, trendy pieces of clothing, accessories, and even home decor! I love how the app recommends similar styles to what I’m looking for. The app is intuitive and easy to use. Processing and shipping is fast—I usually receive my items in approximately one week from China (I live in Florida)! I love that they reward clients for writing reviews because pictures on real bodies help me to figure out sizing. I took off one star because when you purchase items on sale and use a coupon for the non-sale items, it discounts off of the original price and sometimes you pay *more* than the item’s sale price. I also wish there was an easy way to contact customer service or a FAQ section because I’m always guessing my size (is an XL the same as OXL?). Shein makes it super easy to return the items that don’t fit which is why I don’t mind buying in bulk. Because the reviews are so helpful, I end up keeping 80% of my purchase! I’ve received SO many compliments on the pieces I’ve ordered. I don’t have a big discretionary income monthly and it’s nice to be able to treat yourself every now and then for a few bucks.

title: Just a poor girl who loves fashion.
content:
I’ve made 8 separate purchases now totaling just under $800. Not kidding when I say this is awesome. (No I am not sponsored and I don’t work for SHEIN). I didn’t try SHEIN for years because I thought they’d be just like every other Chinese based fashion site that rips people off. NOPE! I’m hooked.

I DO HAVE ADVICE! Check measurements on every single item you’re interested in. Their sizing is not consistent. One shirt I wear an XS and the next I may wear a large. Also, you can tell in some photos if something is just really bad quality. Pay attention. So far out of $800 worth of stuff, I’ve only ONE shirt has not quite been what I thought it would be. Even then… the color was right and the size was right. It just wasn’t as long as the picture. I like my stuff to run long.

I’m so happy with SHEIN. Yes… the garments are lower quality than if you shopped at Nordstrom… but DUH! You get what you pay for and I love their stuff.

title: Unpredictable! Shoppers beware!
content: Last summer I bought my daughter a few swimsuits from Shein and they fit perfectly. Decent quality for a child who doesn’t have to worry about support or cup sizes. Very cute. Although, for Christmas this year, she wanted “oversized” sweatshirts with different cities in the country on them. I was hesitant bc of the print being something I’d doubt would last long, but that’s what she really wanted. So at about $8/piece, I bought 10 of the same style/size. I not expecting high quality for $8… however, the swimsuits were all about $8, were very consistent with sizes, wore pretty nice, looked exactly as the shown in the picture… Let me tell you lol- these sweatshirts were everything except what I used to describe the swimsuits lol. Not any two are the same size! Some are short & fat, others are long & skinny. Sizes that would fit anyone from a mens large to a toddlers small. I looked seeing I must had messed up when ordering. Nope! The colors are all off. Nothing looks like the sample colors! I don’t even think it’s a possibility to return these? I’ve heard returning items is a nightmare with this company. Not all is bad… figured I’ll do a good deed and donate them to the homeless. ALSO BEWARE OF FAKE REVIEWS! They must give incentives for good reviews bc there’s no way all those people are happy with those sweatshirts! Impossible! I wouldn’t say I’ll never order from them again… maybe swimsuits next year for my daughter if she’s not developed… but as far as clothes go? Never again lol.

title: Love it
content: I love this app so much. They have affordable, good clothes for men, women, and kids. They also have a whole bunch of other stuff. They even have home decor. One major thing I will say though about the clothes is that you HAVE TO CHECK THE MEASUREMENTS. For example, something might be a medium, but the bust is 28in. Also, check the reviews ofc, to see what other people say. Sometimes it runs large, small, etc. Sometimes it’s a little thinner or more cropped than expected. They have a size thing that you can do (if you can’t find it on the app just look it up) and it will show you your likely sizes based on your measurements and your size compared to other brands. Then, it will tell you specifically what your size most likely is. But, if other people say it runs large or smaller, don’t go off what it tells you.

title: Had My Doubts - Happy With Results
content: I am indeed a human person making this review haha! I can say as someone who tried to stay away from Shein for as long as possible out of fear that it was too good to be true, I was convinced by my friends to get over my fears and try it anyways. I tried it last month and made 3 haul purchases (the stuff is so cheap in price I just couldn’t help myself). I was biting my nails waiting and when the items arrived I was bursting at the seems with excitement. I unwrapped my products…and was completely BLOWN away! As a plus size gal it’s so hard to go shopping for myself online, it’s virtually impossible and I hate trying on clothes in person because of stuff doesn’t fit right I get really discouraged and I feel bad about myself. EVERYTHING fit. When I say that I mean EVERYTHING. And not only did it fit, but it was so flattering. The quality has been beautiful. I stick to the advice of my friends of only buying things that have a lot of reviews and that have reviews with photos so I can see what I’m getting. This has not left me down. The false nails I have bought are stunning and sturdy. I went to a concert wearing head to toe Shein and I was getting so many compliments and my clothes stayed perfect and my nails stayed on for the ENTIRE night even despite the crowd getting a little rough and crazy in parts. This has changed how I shop, and I save money while feeling better about how I dress. I’m able to put more effort into looking how I want to instead of dressing how I can afford to. I love it. Follow the advice of my friends and you will love it too! If you don’t like your clothes, return them! Super simple and easy process. Shoes are sturdy and cute, jewelry is everything you want it to be, and the clothes are fabulous! Go for it!!

title: Meine Sucht
content: Also ich habe meine erste Bestellung ca. Juni 2020 aufgegeben und ich war so begeistert von der Qualität sowie den Preisen. Natürlich gibt es manchmal Artikel die weniger qualitativ sind, aber die Rückgabe ist so einfach, dass es kein Problem ist. Das ganze wurde zu einer Sucht und ich habe angefangen jeden Abend durch Shein zu scrollen. Dann ergeben sich halt mal mehrere Bestellungen im Monat haha. Abgesehen davon gibt es Kleidung die bestimmten Marken sehr ähnelt. Die Mädels wissen was ich meine Kleider die normalerweise 60€ kosten sind auf shein für die Hälfte erhältlich und von der Qualität auch ganz gut. Warum ich die Sterne abgezogen habe, hat ganz einfach den Grund das die Preise drastisch angestiegen sind. Das rentiert sich für mich überhaupt nicht mehr. Nun kann ich für die Preise die originalen Kleidungsstücke aus anderen Läden holen. Find ich sehr schade, aber jetzt bestelle ich wenigstens weniger als davor. Das Punkte System ist genial man kann seine Punkte in den Bestellungen einsetzten und bekommt somit die Ware für einen billigeren Preis. (Im Vergleich zu anderen Läden, bei denen man erst ab 250 Punkten einen Coupon bekommt, macht Shein einiges besser).

title: The Best Shopping App I’ve Ever Used ~
content: SHEIN not only has cheap clothes, but they are decent quality too. When some items come in, however ~ you can tell they were cheaply made, but when you put it on - it doesn’t make you LOOK cheap. I always feel so confident in all of the clothes I’ve bought from SHEIN. It also has an EXTREMELY easy to use app that almost doubles as a second Pinterest. You can make boards for different items you want to save to buy later, and SHEIN makes it pretty easy and fun to earn points for making posts and leaving reviews. This incentivizes other shoppers to leave reviews on items which always helps me decide what size would be best before ordering something. Lastly, You can get a lot for a little and the shipping time always arrives earlier than the stated dates. I am thoroughly happy shopping with SHEIN and I highly recommend it.

title: Give it a try
content:
So I have mixed feelings with this website. I absolutely LOVE the variety of styles, designs, and choices for unbeatable prices. I can get a really cool and unique shirt on here for $15 at the most, where most top brands you pay $55 for a plain T shirt. Yes, the quality of clothes are good from everything I’ve bought. Most of my wardrobe is from SHEIN. The clothes are real and legit. The material always varies but I’ve gotten some really soft shirts and nothing is too obviously cheap material. The jeans are really good and cheap as well.
Now for the problems with this app:
I’m only 115 pounds and almost everything I order ends up being too small. I’m normally a medium but on here I have to order almost everything in large. I think it’s cause I have a big chest. I would really like to see a section for big chested girls. Next, I really don’t like supporting the environmental destruction that fast fashion causes. I see that they are starting to implement more clothes made of recycled material. If they could aim to switch to at least 50% being recycled then this would be my favorite brand in the world. Last, the recommendation system needs to be worked on because even though there’s hundreds of thousands of styles on here, it seems like the app only shows me the same 20 or so things in my recommendations. I wanna see more variety. Overall very good app if you need affordable clothing.

title: GREAT ALL ROUND
content:
I live in Greece and it is really difficult getting stuff from the U.K. now. Some things take three months to reach me if sent by standard mail.
SHEIN orders normally arrive in 10 to 12 days which is great as I am on a Greek island.
So far I have been impressed with the quality of the items ordered and the sizing has proved excellent when buying clothes. I put in my own measurements on the app and it tells me which size is appropriate for each item. Also you can look at the reviews from others who often attach photos of themselves wearing the item which gives a more realistic view if you are not 6 feet tall and a size XS.
The prices are amazing and this year I have purchased all my swimwear and summer dresses from SHEIN. Everything has been perfect and I have not had to return anything.

title: Nice clothes with very inconsistent sizing
content:
I love the clothing on SHEIN, however, the clothing all varies in both size and quality. Sometimes, you luck out and get something really nicely made, and sometimes, you get a super thin, see-through piece 2 sizes too big.  Unlike most other stores, I’ve noticed most of their items tend to run a little large instead of small, which in my opinion is not always a bad thing. Being plus size, it’s often difficult to find stylish, form-fitting, clothing that I personally like. Everything made in my size is always huge, has ugly slogans on it like “#BOSSBABE”, or has an ugly cut/shape. Everything on SHEIN is modern and fashionable. My only gripe with this site is it’s so difficult for me to find things in my correct size. I know I’m normally a 2X and I always do extensive research on each piece before purchasing, but for some reason, I still manage to get the wrong size often. I wish they would work on this and help make the sizing and quality more consistent. Either way, give it a shot! It’s worth trying out their clothing for yourself. Everything is super affordable and their outfits are so cute! Just make sure you read all the reviews as well as the size chart to figure out which size you should be purchasing.
Good luck and happy shopping! ☺️🥰

Overall, I would go with shein being great. And also, if you are into aesthetic trends and fashion like me. Shein provides inexpensive trendy clothing! I think it’s a good experience for young ladies to try shein and see if it’s the best shopping place. I personally like it and will continue to shop on there! :)

title: トラウマになりました
content:
1度だけ購入した者です。2週間で家に届き試着をし何も問題なく満足していたのですが、その日の夜、服に触れた部分に痒みを感じ鏡で自分の体を見たら蕁麻疹ができていました。もともとダニ・ハウスダストアレルギー持ちなので、こういうことは稀にあります。しかし次の日の朝蕁麻疹は全身に広がり、顔から肩、腕、お腹背中、お尻、太腿、手足の指の先まで皮膚疾患が起こりました。そして昼は一瞬めまいと呼吸困難に陥り、アナフィラキシーまでも起こしてしまい大惨事なりました。
こんなことは人生で初めてで、通販サイトで服を買うことに恐怖を覚えてしまいました。周りの友達の多くがこのサイトを利用していて、商品が届く・届かない問題は耳にした事はありましたが、私のような状態に陥った例なかったので本当に驚いています。普通の人はそうはならないのだとは思いますが、ここで売られている服はきっと想像を超えるほど汚れた場所で保管されている可能性があるということを、このサイトを利用している方に伝えたいと思いコメントを残しておきます。
とても可愛い商品でしたのに非常に残念です。

title: 저렴한 가격. 배송 극악. 고객관리 없음
content:
현재 날짜 : 21.07.13

5월에 이 어플을 광고로 보고 나서 평이 나쁘지 않길래 설치. 상품 가격이 매우매우 괜찮고, 한국어 이외에도 리뷰가 많아서 도움이 되었음. 원하는 상품을 찾아 차곡차곡 담고 5월 31일 주문 완료.

배송의 종류는 일반 배송(flat rate shipping)과 특급 배송(express shipping)으로 나뉘지만 이때는 배송이 나뉘어 있는줄도 몰라서 그냥 50달러 넘게 채우고 무료 일반 배송으로 시킴.

예상 배송일은 14~27일 이내 배송이었지만 이미 리뷰를 보고 앱을 깔았기 때문에 넉넉히 한달 기다린다 생각하고 주문했음. 주문할때 예상 배송 날짜보다 한달이 더걸리고 있는데(주문 날짜로부터 44일째…) 배송 지연 메일 하나 딸랑 오고 0.3달러 할인쿠폰 오고 끝. 아무리 그래도 이건 너무하지 않나 해서 앱을 뒤져봐도 고객센터는 보이지 않음.

장점은 확실하지만, 옷을 살때 이렇게 스트레스 받을거면 그냥 돈더내고 국내 쇼핑몰 앱 쓰는게 나을것같음… 비추

Having ordered a few times now from this app I think I can safely provide an honest review… the app itself I have no faults, discounts and active bonuses/points you can find yourself getting cheap clothing even cheaper!
The items itself is a bit touch and go although 98%of the item I’ve purchased have been as advertised (the key is to read the reviews) and great quality but you have got to be wary on sizes… be sure to read enough reviews on items to way up the size you need to order. The quality for what you pay is brilliant also. Delivery times vary but usually within the estimated time I’ve order with express shipping and got that in 2 day!!! Other times was 14 days. Orders usually end up coming in separate deliveries also due to being stored in separate warehouses but again always arrives in the time given.

Almost no plus sizes ever! Using barely plus sized models for their plus section while also giving them less options. Here’s an idea- get rid of the plus size section. Separating “plus size” from “women” firstly is offensive because it implies we aren’t women, and also why make different clothes for us all?? Just offer the same clothes in bigger sizes it’s very simple. In conclusion, I like SHIEN as it has helped me be able to afford clothing, is fast and the app is easy to use. However, it desperately needs some updating and ethics.

title: Newly Infatuated and Obsessed With Shein
content:
I recently discovered this store/site as I was searching for an affordable curvy plus size dress to wear for an upcoming wedding and not only have I found an abundance of dress options, there is so much more! Unfortunately for us curvy girls, the options are usually limited and the prices ridiculously high. I usually feel we are being taken advantage of for being curvy. NOT THE CASE WITH SHEIN!
There are a variety of styles and colors in all shapes and sizes, special coupons and points earned for purchases, an easy to use website and app and the prices are unbeatable!

I have already placed two orders within a week, gotten tons of good deals and I’m getting ready to place a third order as we speak. I wish they would open brick and mortar stores here in the states because I know they would do so well. I am in love with Shein and I’d be amazed if you are not as well!

title: Fave Place to Shop
content: Originally I was hesitant to order from Shein because like most people I thought it would take months to receive my order (if it ever arrived) and the sizes would be too small. Boy was I wrong. After a close friend told me that she loved them, she recommended I give them a try. Her best advice to me was to look at the reviews and order the size based on what others said “runs small”, “runs big”, “no stretch”, etc. A year later and I’ve probably ordered close to 50 things. Some weren’t for me and I returned those easy enough but most stuff I’ve been shocked at how good the quality is! Last 4 weddings I’ve attended I’ve worn dresses from Shein and I always get compliments every time. And it’s not just clothing, don’t skimp out on the home and kitchen section! I bought a bag resealed for $2 and I’m obsessed with it. If you’re thinking of ordering from Shein, do it! You will not regret it and I bet you’ll become a fan just as fast as I did.

title: Not a Scam
content: I’ve had a SHEIN account for a long time but in 2019 is where I started to actually buy their product. If you don’t get the size you wanted most likely you measured yourself wrong. Do not click M or S or L right away. SHEIN provides measurements, comments, the likelihood of the product you are looking at in a percentage. It’s all there. Yes there were some clothes I didn’t like because it didn’t match or I would rather have it more loose or tighter. It’s not a scam and if you don’t like something you can return it. Obviously undergarments cannot be returned. Their coupons and the point system is really awesome unlike others like forever 21 or ulta. Their makeup is good and some are gems. I’ve been buying my eyeliner and it’s the only one that I truly love and it costs 4-5 dollars. Saves money and hard not to buy anything.

title: App doesn’t show all products categorically
content: Although I love many aspects about SHEIN products, many ratings aren’t honest because they are rewarded with points ONLY if you give a glowing and positive perfect review. Points are redeemed like cash. It’s a mixture of cheap products with quality. Sale prices are sometimes hours. If you turn off notifications you also miss delivery notices. They aren’t unfair but it is pressure based selling. They also don’t discount plus sizes equally as regular sizes and the size runs are different piece to piece even with color variants. They DO however give detailed descriptions. You also will never be able to see al products within a category no matter what, because exact products are worded differently to mix up user searches. So let’s say you want a coat or jacket, logically you search jackets/outerwear and think you get to see all the products but you don’t. There will be hundreds more that are technically in a basic category like jackets/outerwear but are listed as something different on searches. It’s actually genius marketing. There are “shadow categories” that have designers as well that aren’t listed in main search categories that just pop up, but not consistently. I’ve months on the app, I’m a big window shopper before I buy a big order. Sometimes mid scroll the app blanks out. I like the swipe me how fast the app allows browsing. I don’t like the algorithm of the app learning what I like. I don’t need that part. So if you view a cold shoulder top and scroll it will show you more cold shoulder tops and from then forward the app tries to show you the same 37 cold shoulder tops even if you bought it like enough please

title: My review
content:
I came across this app from an old friend, I asked her where her outfit was from and she was like, ‘shein of course!’  Wondering why I’d never heard or come across this app, I asked my mum if she’d ever heard of it and she told me she’s actually done quite a few orders from here, all good quality and comfortable fit. I decided to download it, even though I don’t normally order offline however when COVID-19 hit, I decided to have a little go at online shopping. After about 3 hours of scrolling through and adding items to my basket on shein, I realised I had over 200 items!!
It became my go-to shopping app as it’s not only clothes they have but accessories such as handbags, earrings, necklaces, phone cases, hats, rings, pop it’s and more.
I’ve done about 7 orders off Shein and all of my items have been extraordinary, comfortable fits, cute outfits, good prices, amazing quality and always true to size!
I mean, what more could you want?
If I’m going to be honest, it’s become a bit of an addictive app which I don’t see as a bad thing.
The only thing I will say is that it takes at least maybe a week and a half to arrive and if you have a big order it may be split into different packages so they will come at different times but in my case that’s only ever happened once and it was a Tuesday then a Thursday so it wasn’t that far apart.
I’d recommend shein for anyone. It’s so amazing and I’m absolutely in love with this app! 🤪😝

title: Love this app!
content:
SHEIN is an incredibly fun, addicting site to browse and buy on. I’ve purchased about 10 items from it so far and for the most part have not been disappointed. If I have any complaints at all it’s primarily due to size issues, but I put that more on myself and besides that can happen anywhere. The other negative is that they do sell highly offensive items (i.e. women posing in crude lingerie that borders on nudity. I don’t consider a thin string of cloth across someone’s @$$crack as being “clothed”), and sometimes it’s hard to avoid the more offensive merchandise if you’re searching for, say, swimwear or sleepwear.
Even so, I love being able to get really cute, unique clothing for less money. As for the quality, I’m very happy with it. I try to purchase cotton only and I find their 100% cotton clothing to look and feel great, especially for the price. I try to stay away from polyester because it’s cheap, but even the few polyester items I caved in and bought turned out to be better than expected.
Another perk is that you can earn points on SHEIN by reviewing items you d purchased. Granted, a lot of users are clearly only interested in earning points because there’s a trend of posting music lyrics instead of typing out a helpful review (even worse is that people seem to think it’s funny and give these useless “reviews” thumbs up.) Still, the points you earn add up and you can apply them at checkout for a discount. Takes a while to get any substantial amount knocked off your cart’s total but it’s worth it if you shop there anyway.
Overall, I really like SHEIN and browse their app almost every day.

Overall, it’s not a bad app. It’s legit.

title: Lovely but delivery is not good enough.
content:
I don’t usually leave reviews but I’ve been ordering from SHIEN for about 9 months now for myself, 10yo daughter, 3yo son and my husband.

I would say generally that 8/10 my orders have been fab. Items are priced decently and I can spend hours just browsing the site.

The not so good parts are lack of ability to contact an actual person. I’ve found the best way is to DM on Twitter. You get a robot response initially then it seems a real person takes over. I’m in the U.K. and with the pandemic, it’s meaning it does take a fair amount of time to be delivered - not necessarily SHIENs though but it was the same before COVID. When a £300+ order didn’t arrive they did actually refund me the full amount after they had investigated which took about 4 weeks.

The clothes for older girls (I have a 10yo) are lovely, fashionable and do wash well. I don’t order her clothes from any one else now.

The clothes for younger boy ‘s.... unfortunately are no where near as fashionable, the quality isn’t always great either to be honest. Also, there limited choice in comparison to other departments.

A little tip - always read the item reviews before buying.

Over all though, I love the company, I do just wish communication and deliveries were a lot more reliable as I do worry every time I order that it just simply won’t turn up.

Kayley Mayho 🙂

So maybe try to make those types of things available.

content:
good, easy app. pretty organised & easy to place orders (not that i do- i never shop here) - however, i REALLY refrain you from shopping with shein.

they are notoriously known for super duper cheap items- but why do you think these items are so dirt cheap? $2 for a top? how much do you think this company is spending on

-paying delivery services
-paying people to produce the fabric

-the manufacturing that’s necessary to produce the fabric

they have also been known for stealing designs from small businesses & selling them on with 0 shame and 0 credit to the original designers- people like you & me- trying to make money.

thank you so much for reading this. i REALLY hope this changes your perspective. this shop disgusts me. do NOT give them your money- shop small- second hand- sustainable.

thanku, have a nice day/ night!

title: Great app- but a few suggestions!
content: I love SHEIN and overall the app is super easy to navigate I just think a few improvements could be made. For one, I think on the app you should be able to select the date under the “new in” section like you are able to on the traditional website format. This would allow me to look at the app every day and filter to see what new stuff was added, without having to search through all the other “new in” items I saw the day before, and 2 days prior, etc. I also think it would be best if the “check in” to earn your points popped up as soon as you opened up the app- like many game apps do for “daily tokens” and whatnot, because even though I’m on the app at least once a day I usually don’t remember to go to the check in page to earn my points. Finally, I think the main search feature should have an option to filter just “plus size” because currently you can search for an item description and filter it to a size of your choosing, for example 1XL, but a lot of the time I will buy a size smaller or bigger than my general size based on size descriptions, so I’d like to see all the plus size options available without also seeing the clothes that come in only straight sizes. Hope these suggestions are useful!

title: My go to for inexpensive stuff!
content: I tried Shein when a coworker of mine told me her daughter got box loads of stuff for super cheap. I was super skeptical because I’m a 5’9” mother of 2, still chipping away at the baby weight from my 10 month old. It’s hard enough to find things that fit without factoring in the sizing differences. I was actually very impressed with the Shein experience! All the clothes have a sizing chart by inches and centimeters and they show you on a sliding scale the fit of the garment as well as it’s level of stretch. I wish ALL clothing retailers would use this feature! Next, I was worried that the items that looked so good in pictures would look like garbage when I opened them up. To my surprise, everything l bought was exactly as represented. Some things were even better, like a pair of leggings I got that were made of this awesome fabric I’ve never seen before! Another concern of mine was timing. I thought for SURE it would take forever to get my stuff. I got my box in a matter of DAYS! I couldn’t believe it! I paid via PayPal so I want concerned about my information being leaked or not being able to get my money back, but I was so pleased with everything I didn’t need to even think about that! Over all, if you pay attention and utilize the resources of the Shein app, you shouldn’t have any sizing or fit issues. I was so happy with my purchase for myself, I bought clothes for the baby, my 6yr old and my hubby! He is also hard to fit because he is very tall and has an athletic build so finding clothes fitted enough for his shape and long enough for his height is next to impossible. I also put some of my friends on to Shein and they have happily purchased clothing for themselves, their  kids, their pets and their home! This app and website is definitely worth a shot. Super cute stuff at super cheap prices. I will continue to be a customer if they maintain this same level of integrity!

title: If you don’t mind waiting 2 weeks it’s perfect
content:
SHEIN is one of the few international fashion brands that do plus sizes reasonably well.
Having bought clothes from China previously I was expecting the sizes to run small but SHEIN seem to have the European/American sizes pretty much accurate, they allow users to post reviews with their size measurements so you can gauge if you need to size up/down.
I’ve bought lots of items from underwear to jackets, homewares to kids clothes and they are all good.  I bought spiral hair curlers that are on another well known site for £6 less and I got more curling pieces, they are identical.

Most of our clothing and furnishings come from Chinese factories, so basically you are cutting out the middleman and saving in the process. The only downside to this is the wait for the products.
My last order was here in under 8 days which is pretty impressive considering the journey it makes, my other orders have varied between 10-15 days.
It normally goes from SHEIN to Airfreight in 2/3 days a few days either side for flights and the wait tends to be on the UK side as it goes through customs and is rerouted to Royal Mail for delivery.
If you are not in a rush then it’s definitely worth the wait.

title: Bestellung
content:
Hab ab und zu mal dort bestellt, die Ware kam immer mega spät an, was aber ja normal ist. Aber wehe, du willst was umtauschen: ich hatte ein paar Klamotten bestellt und wollte einiges zurück schicken weil es 1. nicht den Bildern entsprach, 2. Quali schlecht war. Aber was will man von einem China-Shop erwarten. (Anhang: hab auch ein paar coole Teile von dem Shop, ist nicht alles schlecht) Long Story Short: hab nen Retourenschein angefordert, ausgedruckt und die Retoure fertig gemacht. Beim abgeben an DHL meinte die Dame aber das der Retourenschein nicht funktioniert. Sie hat sich wirklich Mühe gegeben aber es hat nichts geklappt. Sie meinte dann ich kann das Paket bezahlen, das hab ich aber nicht eingesehen weil immer mit kostenloser Retoure geworben wird. Ok! Dann hab ich das Paket wieder mit nachhause genommen, habe die Rechnung  bei Klarna vorübergehend pausiert und habe ungefähr zig Mails an diesen Kundenservice geschickt, das ich doch bitte einen neuen Retourenschein haben möchte, aber es kam niiiieeee eine Antwort. Klarna hat sich dann nach 4 Wochen gemeldet, das sie halt endlich ihre Kohle wollen (komplett nachvollziehbar). Hab Klarna dann das Problem geschildert. Daraufhin hat Klarna netterweise 2 Monate auf das Geld verzichtet und mir Zeit gegeben das du klären. Ende der Geschichte: Hab die Rechnung bezahlt, die Sachen behalten müssen und verticke das Zeug jetzt auf Kleiderkreisel.
Absolut unfähiger Kundenservice!

Thanks for reading,
A Shein Lover!

title: The most Horrible website and service
content:
I’m very disgusted with the way SHEIN handles the inconvenience of your order being delivered. I ordered $200 dollars worth of accessories. They shipped my package late. I contact SHEIN by virtual chat. They ask me if I want a refund or reorder. I let them know I want my order because I never received it in the first place and they had already taken out the money from my card. They place the order again and tell me that some of my items are out of stock so I have to take the refund. I explain to them how is that my fault if I didn’t receive the first package. Shein and USPS were giving me the run around. I ask them to accommodate me for the inconvenience and sent my package express shipping so that I can receive it and they told me no. I can just get my refund, that my refund will take 7-14 business days. What baffled me was they were quick to take my money, I still haven’t received neither one of my packages. I would never recommend nor shop on this app ever again.
Angry Customer

title: Cute clothes but everything else is frustrating
content:
I love the items there. However, the shipping is unreasonable. It costs a lot, first off. And if you don't pay like $15 for express shipping, you'll be waiting a while for your items(s). As far as the app itself, its easy to navigate but some features are useless. For example, I don't get the points feature. We earn points but can't even use them all at check out, we can only use a portion. That's stupid, it's like you want us to come out of our pocket every check out, despite us being loyal app members and earning our points to be able to use them to purchase our order solely with our points. Also, another thing that ticks me off is the whole trial report. It's impossible to get picked if you don't have a higher level, yet they don't even explain how to get a higher membership level. If you want more people to buy your clothes, offer more sizes.

Other than that, I can comfortably buy shirts and shorts sometimes too. I love your brand but please start creating long and petite sizes, we would all greatly appreciate it.

Also, when you get a new account, you get offers (£3 off) and also, they give you a 15% off offer. This is GOOD!

Overall, I LOVE Shein! Despite the negative reviews, i had an amazing experience. 10/10 recommend!

I have had to Facebook message them to get ahold of someone and even then, it takes over a day just to get a response. I also advise y’all to pay for the expedited shipping because your package will take multiple weeks and the shipping information will not be updated as fast if you use their free shipping method. I received the expedited shipping order within a week and a half, but I have yet to receive my original order that was placed on April 30. Just pay for expedited shipping and look at the clothing reviews and y’all will receive some awesome clothes for really cheap!

title: Highly Recommend!
content:
Most of the contents of my wardrobe is from this app, I love it!

They have an easy and great rewards system using points that alway give you money off by converting to money. There are lots of free vouchers available that reduce the already low prices!

The clothes are almost always of a high quality and if you ever do get the occasional dud, they issue a full refund immediately in the option you choose to have it (In app money that can be withdrawn or directly into your account). I very very rarely have problems with the items ordered.

They offer an array of products from clothing to beauty to home wear and they cater to a wide range of sizes.

You have easy options to track your parcel to see where it’s up to and you can complete an order and pay within 24 hours later, if there is an issue.

They have flash sales with clothing going as low as 49p a piece or set and they even have in app ‘games’ where you can gain vouchers and points. You can also apply for free trials where you receive a product for free in return for an extensive, honest review and you can complete your own outfits and deigns that can be entered into competitions to win points.

This app makes shopping really fun with a fast moving, very detailed experience. I do find that because of this, it is very addictive and you can find you’ve spent a lot of money, very easily but you get 3 times the amount of products you would have got anywhere else for the price! 😂

My tips for this app are to always read the comments and always look at all the customer images. The more you know about the products, the more you’ll know what to expect. For example, when it says ‘sweatshirt’, 90% of the time the material is thin and more like a T-shirt, it’s just a sweatshirt shape. T-shirt’s also always run slightly on the shorter side. They are very rarely ‘average length’. It’s all still good quality and always look cute but it’s good to know what you’re getting.

I hope you found this helpful!

They have flash sales with clothing going as low as 49p a piece or set and they even have in app ‘games’ where you can gain vouchers and points. You can also apply for free trials where you receive a product for free in return for an extensive, honest review and you can complete your own outfits and deigns that can be entered into competitions to win points. 

This app makes shopping really fun with a fast moving, very detailed experience. I do find that because of this, it is very addictive and you can find you’ve spent a lot of money, very easily but you get 3 times the amount of products you would have got anywhere else for the price! 😂

My tips for this app are to always read the comments and always look at all the customer images. The more you know about the products, the more you’ll know what to expect. For example, when it says ‘sweatshirt’, 90% of the time the material is thin and more like a T-shirt, it’s just a sweatshirt shape. T-shirt’s also always run slightly on the shorter side. They are very rarely ‘average length’. It’s all still good quality and always look cute but it’s good to know what you’re getting. 

I hope you found this helpful!

title: It’s great but…
content:
I had the app on my previous phone and then I downloaded it again on the one I’m using now. The first problem was that, I couldn’t log into my account on the new phone because of my password. In the end, it’s a great app, I love the clothing options but, I would really appreciate it if they could somehow make logging in on various devices more efficient or maybe even add an option where you can ‘Sign in using Google’ to eliminate the hassle of having to remember and/or resetting passwords every now and then. I would also like if they worked on better customer service answers.

title: Review of Shein app and products
content: Shein as an app is amazing. It has a variety of choices for clothing and accessories, its easy to navigate, unlimited wishlist capacity, easy to shop, it offers styling/look suggestions that are very nice, there’s a sizing guide as well—in terms of body fit, their sizing guide is good. However, be careful with length sizing because the clothes do not have special sizes like petite, so dresses can come longer and need a bit of altering for better fit—that’s by far my experience with dress purchase. When it comes to shipping, it takes awhile for the package to arrive because it is shipped from China (2 weeks outmost), so start purchasing early and allow plenty of time if you want clothing for an occasion. The products are what the price’s worth, it offers cheaper products so the durability and quality is within the range of its price, too. If you are looking for cheap clothing that you style and wear but would be happy to let go eventually, then its great to shop here. Overall, my experience with this company was good 😊

title: SHEIN Is My Go-To Shopping App ✨
content:
SHEIN is my absolute first choice out of all the other shopping apps. They have a broad variety of clothing, shoes, jewelry, accessories, etc. The items that are sold on SHEIN are in excellent condition. The quality is fabulous. The prices are unbelievable. They are always running sales, and you can snag amazing outfits and accessories at an absolute STEAL!

There are many ways to save on SHEIN. You can accumulate points by participating in outfit contests, joining in on their live-streams, participating in mini games, and creating your own “fashion show”. There is also a Free Trial Center where you are able to submit applications for specific products for a chance to be selected to try out those products FOR FREE and leave reviews for them, and as you leave reviews for products, you rack up points.

I highly recommend this app. If you are a bargain shopper, like I am, and you like to find amazing, high-quality products at a reasonable price, then SHEIN is for you! Not only is it a way to shop online, but it’s just a really fun experience as you participate in the different events they always have going on.

The only issue is the shipping times and tracking systems, so if you want to order from them, I suggest you order at least 3 weeks in advance and don’t bother with tracking until it’s with your local mail holder and then use their own tracking system.

title: SHEIN is amazing!!
content:
I’m a person who browses a lot of sites, and with that comes online shopping as well. Shein is one of the best sites I’ve ever seen, with affordable prices and a pretty good quality.

Their app is easy to navigate, and includes real people profiles. I love many of the features included within the app. The review system gives a good understanding of what the products comes out to be. I also adore the size chart, and the sizes are very detailed, giving an exact measurement.

I suggest always looking over the reviews if you plan on buying from Shein. Although, majority of clothing items are great quality, some are deceiving. The reviews and size chart gives a good idea. There is usually 5-20 reviews per item, and it helps a ton. I always go through each one, to see whether I need a size difference, or even if I would like the material.

I love the kids section, as many other brands online don’t have a ton of clothes for kids unless they are a larger company. The clothes aren’t so girly and sparkly like some other stores, and really fits anyone’s style.

The fact that Shein offers accessories and add-ons is amazing as well! They are sturdy and very beautiful. I would just recommend that they were also sold in one pieces, since most come in bundles or bunches of jewelry. The bags are beautiful!

Overall, Shein is a lifechanger. Their clothing varies, but is fashionable.

title: Love the clothes, not the customer service.
content:
I have been shopping on this app for two years. My closet is FULL of clothes from SHEIN. The app is very easy to use and once you get the swing of proper measurements, you will love it! I hardly ever run across anything ill fitting (and I’m fairly curvy). The comments and reviews are wonderful for help with sizing and information about the material of the product. It is very affordable and they litter you with flash deals and coupons! I always feel very thrifty shopping here!

With that being said, SHEIN has some of the worst customer service I’ve ever experienced. In two years, I’ve only had to contact them a handful of times, but it is always the same routine. It’s takes about two days for a ticket response, they politely tell you you’re wrong about whatever the problem may be but they will help anyways, then throw SHEIN points at you. Trying to call is like pulling teeth. Returning an item, is even more painful. With all of the hoops they make you jump through, it is easier to just cut your loss and donate the item.

I, personally, really enjoy everything I’ve gotten from here. The pros really outweigh the cons for me. I think my items are quality AND affordable. I really hope at the rate they are growing, they focus less on producing more items and more on improving the customer service. That is by far the most frustrating part of this company. With that being said, I will always use this app for my shopping needs and do recommend.

content: Shein's products are very hit and miss on fit and quality for sure. I like that you can get points for reviewing and uploading pictures of their clothes and use those towards future purchases. I don't necessarily like that when you return items it goes into a shein wallet instead of back on your card, but again you can use it towards future purchases.

title: Absolute Abzogge!
content:
Ich habe über die SHEIN-App bzw. Webseite eine größere Bestellung aufgegeben. Die Artikel habe ich lediglich anprobiert und anschließend komplett wieder zurückgeschickt, da sie mir nicht gefallen haben. Der Warenwert war relativ hoch.

Nach der Rücksendung wurde mir jedoch plötzlich vorgeworfen, ich hätte Artikel beschädigt. Für einen Teil der Bestellung habe ich deshalb kein Geld zurückbekommen. Beim restlichen Teil wurde behauptet, ich hätte angeblich falsche Artikel zurückgeschickt, was absolut nicht stimmt. Dadurch bleibe ich jetzt auf den kompletten Kosten sitzen.

Der Kundenservice war ebenfalls keine Hilfe. Ich habe mehrere E-Mails hin und her geschrieben, aber es wurde keinerlei Lösung angeboten. Stattdessen wird man immer wieder mit neuen Behauptungen abgespeist.

Für mich ist das eine große Enttäuschung und wirkt wie eine komplette Abzocke. Absolut nicht kundenfreundlich. Mein Geld werde ich wohl nie wiedersehen. Von mir gibt es daher ganz klar keine Empfehlung für SHEIN.

title: Prices are not Accurate it’s keep changing it
content:
I’ve found the SHEIN shopping experience quite frustrating lately. The prices don’t always seem accurate or consistent, as they keep changing, which makes it difficult to know what you’re actually paying for. There also seems to be a lot of confusion around the products, with so many similar items being displayed at once. It can make it quite difficult to find exactly what you’re looking for, especially when there are so many advertisements and promotional offers appearing throughout the app.

Another thing I find frustrating is the constant encouragement to sign up for the membership. The membership offers and coupons don’t always seem as worthwhile as they are made to appear, and the terms can be difficult to understand. The membership benefits and coupons should be much more straightforward, with clear information about what you’re actually getting and any restrictions that apply.

Overall, SHEIN has a huge range of products and affordable options, but the shopping experience could be much better if the pricing was more consistent, the product selection was less overwhelming, and the membership and coupon system was simpler and more transparent
